newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade moderate $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade moderate $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow to moderate in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 7,700 slaughter steers and 6,100 heifers; 43,500 head confirmed for the week to date including 28,000 head formulated and 900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.

Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 64.00. Select, few Choice 1050-1150 lbs 63.75. Confirmed - 13,800 Week Ago - 11,100 Year Ago - 14,900 Wk to Date - 43,500 Week Ago - 81,300 Year Ago - 35,200
